_comment: Payout multipliers by product. VERIFY against the app before relying on EV output — books change these and run promos. Flex maps hits->multiplier; absent counts pay 0.

prizepicks._arena_note: VERIFIED IN-APP 2026-07-24 across three lineups: the correlation penalty tracks how many legs come from the SAME MATCH, not the same team. 4-pick guarantees: <=2 legs per match -> 10x; 3 legs from one match -> 6.5x; all 4 legs from one match -> 5x (confirmed on a 2 FaZe + 2 DENDELE slip, both teams in the same game). Keys below are max-legs-from-one-match. 2/3/5-pick guarantees still need verifying.
prizepicks._shapes_note: OBSERVED multipliers for exact structural shapes, read off the app. These OVERRIDE the fitted pair_penalty, which is an extrapolation: pair_penalty predicts 9.25x for cross2x2 (10 - 2*0.375) while the app shows 8.5x. An observed price beats a fitted one. IMPORTANT, confirmed by the user 2026-07-25 against the app: for a 4-man Power Play in this shape, 8.5x IS the payout. The card also shows a '1st place pays 10X' line, but that belongs to a separate contest prize and does NOT apply to this entry — do not treat 8.5x as a floor with 10x upside, and do not add any tournament premium to EV. 8.5x is the number, full stop.

shapes.name: cross2x2
shapes._seen: user-reported, multiple boards, 2026-07-25. One player from each side of two different matches; the two legs inside a match share a direction (both over or both under).

prizepicks._ladder_note: VERIFIED from the app's own 'Player Pick Lineup standard payout rates' card, 2026-07-26. These are STANDARD rates. The Arena/contest product pays LESS for the same lineup — a 4-pick Power is 10x standard but 8.5x in Arena, and 4-of-4 Flex is 6x standard but 5x in Arena (3-of-4: 1.5x standard, 1.25x Arena). The `correlated` and `shapes` blocks above describe Arena. Two earlier config values were simply wrong: the 3-pick Power was 5.0 (really 6.0) and the 6-pick Power was 25.0 (really 37.5), which made both look far worse than they are.
prizepicks._structures_note: 4-pick POWER multiplier by slip STRUCTURE, ALL user-read in-app 2026-08-02 (standard entries): 1+1+1+1 pays the full 10x; 2+1+1 (one teammate pair + two singles) pays 9.5x — so on 4-pick entries even the FIRST pair is charged, unlike the 5-pick tests where one pair rode free; 2+2 (two teammate pairs, two matches) pays 7.5x — the earlier 8.0x extrapolation was wrong; 3+1 (teammate triple + single) pays 6.75x, correcting the older 6.5x reading; 4-in-one-match (2+2 across both teams) pays 5x. The user reports these as fixed for the format regardless of which players fill it.

underdog._correlated_note: INFERRED, NOT VERIFIED — mirrors the PrizePicks pattern confirmed in-app 2026-07-24, keyed on max legs from a SINGLE MATCH (<=2 free, 3 penalised, 4 penalised hard). Check Underdog's own payout display before trusting these.
underdog._power_note: VERIFIED from Underdog's own payout page 2026-07-26. Their SMALL slips are the best-priced products across both books: the 2-pick holds 12.5% and the 3-pick 18.75%, against 25%+ everywhere on PrizePicks. Corrections made: 3-pick was 6.0 (really 6.5); the 5-pick flex tier was 12x/2.5x/0.4x (really 10x/2.5x with NO 3-of-5 tier at all — a 5-pick flex that drops two legs pays zero, which the old config scored as 0.4x). Note the flex ladder only pays 2 losses at 6 picks and up.
underdog._structures_note: Underdog shifts the payout on ANY same-match pair (user-observed 2026-07-26) and the shifted magnitudes were never captured, so only the fully diversified structure carries a trusted price. Structures missing here are skipped by the structure search rather than guessed at.
